text:
[LLEX.13.2.1] Interpolation sites `{…}` and literal-brace escapes `{{` /
`}}` are **not** lexer concerns. They are parsed in a second
pass over the `STRING_LIT` content by the parser or its
client, per the interpolation sub-grammar in [LGRA.11]. The
lexer treats `{` and `}` inside a string as ordinary
characters. Validation of interpolation syntax happens when the
`STRING_LIT`'s value is consumed in an action-argument
position.
